newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Beach signs East Korea Bay farm-in.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Beach signs East Korea Bay farm-in.

text.p: Beach Petroleum NL said on Tuesday it planned to enter into a free-carry exploration agreement with Malaysia's Puspita Emas Sdn Bhd under which Puspita will fund a US$1 million seismic survey of Beach's East Korea Bay Production Sharing Concession (PSC) in North Korea.

Puspita will earn a 25 percent participating interest in the PSC. On completion of the seismic survey, Puspita could earn either an additional 50 percent interest by drilling one offshore well or 65 percent by drilling two wells, Beach said.
The wells were expected to cost about US$10 million each.
Beach will remain the operator of the PSC.
The East Korea Bay Basin, virtually untested by the drill, was surrounded by major oil producing areas, the company said.
The agreement is subject to shareholder approval and a transaction that will see Puspita buy shares held in Beach by Enterprise Gold Mines NL.
The net proceeds of A$1.9 million flowing from the sale will be given to Beach to partially discharge a debt owed to it by Enterprise.
The transaction will bring Puspita's stake in Beach to 14.2 percent.
At 0511 GMT (3.11 p.m.) Beach shares were up A$0.004 to A$0.08.
